findings.F1: The book's mean daily gain of 0.1265 % breaks down into 0.1009 % from the market's own rise (mean position 0.78 of the book) and only 0.0256 % from timing (t 0.43, 2898 days); per year the book tracks holding closely (2021: 0.32 % against 0.45 % a day; 2022: −0.09 % against −0.18 %), so its Sharpe edge comes from being mostly long a rising set of coins, not from streaks.
findings.F2: The trades' profit is carried by a handful of trades: the top 5 % of 1244 trades sum to 15879 of the 15900 total net percent, only 40.6 % of trades are positive, and the median trade is −1.60 % against a mean of +12.78 %.
findings.F3: The forecast hits its +20 cap at entry in three of the four entry-forecast quartiles, and net trade results do not rise across those quartiles (+12.6, +12.8, +8.9, +16.9 %); on all active bars the unusual 20-day move by forecast quartile is not graded either (+3.4 %, −1.0 %, −4.8 %, +0.6 %; every t under 1.3).
findings.F4: Streak length on its own shows no graded follow-on move: the unusual 20-day move by signed streak from −5 to +5 has no |t| above 1.8 with at least 20 case days, and the 5-day moves have no |t| above 2.0 over about 6150 cases; this holds inside the trending regime too.
findings.F5: Other angles also show nothing above chance. By 20-day past-return quintile the 20-day move is U-shaped but weak (top +3.9 %, t 1.37; top and active +6.6 %, t 1.62, 47 days). By 60-day return the largest |t| is 1.66. By 20-day volatility it is 1.49. By the size of the day's move (next day, 5 days) it is 1.51. By weekday it is 1.76. The one large t, −4.9 in the middle quintile of distance from the 90-day high, rests on 40 cases over 13 days, is not monotone, and is one of about 60 cells examined.

no_ideas: Across streaks, forecast size, regime, past 20- and 60-day returns, volatility, daily shocks, weekday and distance from highs, no pattern stood out beyond what the many angles examined would produce by chance; the book's gain is the coins' own drift (F1) carried by a few outlier trades (F2), with no graded effect to build an idea on (F3–F5).
